name: Pomodoro
description: A pet tomato that counts your pomodoros: a status bar timer, an animated panel, a break after each focus, and a notification when each one ends.

cover.alt: A pixel-art tomato named Pomodoro next to the panel, which shows a finished pomodoro and proposes a 15 minute break.

screenshots.alt: The Pomodoro panel counting down 18:42 in focus, with the tomato inside a red progress ring and the status bar item showing 18:42 and 3 pomodoros.
screenshots.caption: Focus, with the countdown in the status bar

screenshots.alt: The panel after a pomodoro ends: Done, a Take break button, and a Break row with 5 and 15 minutes, 15 selected on the 4th pomodoro, and Skip.
screenshots.caption: A break is proposed when a pomodoro ends

screenshots.alt: The panel in a dark theme during a break: a green ring, a sleeping tomato and 11:40 left.
screenshots.caption: Breaks get a green ring and a sleeping tomato

screenshots.alt: The panel in a dark theme, paused with 16:00 left and today at 6 pomodoros, with minus and plus buttons to correct the count.
screenshots.caption: Today’s count, with − and + to fix it

statusBarItems.tooltip: Pomodoro: click to open the panel

settings.title: Focus minutes
settings.description: Default length of a pomodoro, in minutes (1 to 180).
